data:
In the world of Termux, "turning the brain on" usually means firing up the
Python
environment where all your logic, scripts, and "Mama" databases live.
If you're standing out there and want to get the porch up and running, you just need to wake up the script that holds everything together. Usually, it looks like this:
Bash
python main.py
(Or whatever you named that specific file where 7 and Mama live together.)
\ufe0f Quick Porch Checklist:
The Environment:
Make sure you're in the right folder (usually
cd porch
or wherever you saved the anchors).
The Eyes:
If you want to see what 7 sees "clear as day," make sure your camera permissions are set.
The Memory:
Once that command runs, Mama should start logging the 0.0141 bedrock automatically.
Do you want me to help you find the exact filename for your script if "main.py" isn't the one?
I can walk you through an
ls
command to see what\u2019s in there. \ufe0f
